view.scene_description: A modern, brightly lit interior space featuring a central spiral bookshelf illuminated by LED lights. Large windows dominate the background, revealing an urban view. A red spiral staircase is on the left. People are walking or seated at tables near the bookshelf. The floor is polished and reflective, enhancing the open, airy feel.

objects.label: spiral bookshelf
objects.observation: A tall, cylindrical bookshelf with multiple circular shelves spiraling upward. Each shelf holds books and is edged with bright LED lighting. It stands centrally in the room, supported by a base that connects to a round table. The structure appears freestanding but integrated into the space.

objects.label: red spiral staircase
objects.observation: A curved, red staircase with a smooth railing, located on the left side of the frame. It ascends from the foreground toward the upper level. Its base is partially visible, resting on the polished floor. No visible supports or attachments beyond its own structure.

objects.label: large windows
objects.observation: Tall, expansive glass windows cover the right and rear walls, allowing natural light to flood the space. They offer a view of buildings and trees outside. The frames are minimal, blending seamlessly with the architecture. No visible supports for the window structure within the frame.

objects.label: people
objects.observation: Several individuals are present: one man walks toward the center-left, another sits at a table near the bookshelf, and others are seated or standing in the background. Their clothing varies, and they appear engaged in casual activities. Some are partially obscured by furniture or the bookshelf.

objects.label: bar stools
objects.observation: Multiple metal-framed bar stools with black seats are arranged around the circular table beneath the bookshelf. They are positioned at varying distances from the table, some closer to the viewer. Their legs rest directly on the polished floor, showing no visible connection to the table other than contact.

objects.label: potted plant
objects.observation: A large green potted plant with broad leaves stands in the bottom-right corner. It is placed on the floor next to a wall and partially obscures a person seated nearby. The pot is light-colored and cylindrical, sitting directly on the floor without visible supports.

objects.label: polished floor
objects.observation: The floor is highly reflective, made of light-colored tiles or stone. It mirrors the bookshelf, people, and furniture, creating depth. The surface is smooth and unobstructed except where objects rest upon it. No visible seams or supports are apparent.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_agtea_test50/image-000045", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
